nodes.label: Core-core term dcc at row 89, non-perturbative closure
nodes.rationale: Closes the row-89 total dm2 in [+0.08, +0.12] Ha with no flip against the 0.03233 margin, and bounds the change from the perturbative value (+0.066) at under 0.01 Ha so the resummation is shown not to be load-bearing for the verdict.

nodes.label: Two-state resummation of the ent 7s^2 -> 6d^2 block
nodes.rationale: E_exact = -(Delta/2)(sqrt(1 + 4|E_PT|/Delta) - 1) with Delta ~ 0.47 filed: |E_exact| < |E_PT| is sign-exact by convexity, so a near-degenerate block is handled exactly instead of trusting a perturbative denominator.

nodes.label: Slot-rule decision can-fail (PASS under (1-f), FAIL under exclusion)
nodes.rationale: Uses the CORE object's own 6p-7s pair as a reference with no 6d anywhere in core, so the test is external to v5 and decides between the two slot rules by opposite expected outcomes rather than by preference.
